entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally! I want to return a helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference? The color is HIDEOUS! It looks nothing like the picture on your website. I wouldn't be caught dead in this thing. I want my money back, now.
I understand your frustration when an item's color doesn't meet your expectations. I just need to ask for your order number to pull up the details.
It's VF-8675309. And don't give me any runaround. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet. This should be simple.
Thank you. I see the order here. It was delivered 23 days ago. Is that correct?
So what? Are you trying to get out of this? I want to speak to your manager. This is ridiculous. I'll post a review so bad it'll sink your whole company!

There's no need for that, sir. I can absolutely resolve this for you. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I'm just confirming the details. Please give me one moment to review our policy for you.
You'd better. This is the last time I buy anything from VeloFit.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've checked our policy, and for a standard item like this helmet, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. No problem at all.
Oh. Ninety days? Well... okay then. That's fine. So you're going to send me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Okay. Good. That's what I expected in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
